name: SCICOM
recent: SCICOM 将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 24 届常年股东大会，并已发布 2026 年报。公司于 9 月派发第四次中期股息每股 3.0 仙，同时一名大股东兼董事在 10 月多次申报股权变动。近期新闻提及公司计划以自资模式拓展国际 govtech 边境基础设施业务。
notable: 将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 24 届常年股东大会。
派发第四次中期单层股息每股 3.0 仙，除息日 9 月 11 日，支付日 9 月 30 日。
一名大股东兼董事在 10 月 13 日至 15 日多次申报股权变动。
risks: 大股东兼董事在 10 月多次申报股权变动，具体增减未在标题中说明。
一名股东于 9 月 14 日发出停止成为主要股东的通知（Notice of Person Ceasing）。

recent_en: The company paid a fourth interim dividend of 3.0 sen per share in September, while a substantial shareholder and director filed multiple changes in interest in October. Recent news mentioned plans to expand internationally with a self-funding govtech border infrastructure model.
notable_en: The 24th Annual General Meeting will be held on 7 Dec 2026.
A fourth interim single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share was declared, with ex-date 11 Sep and payment date 30 Sep.
A substantial shareholder and director filed multiple changes in interest between 13 and 15 October.
risks_en: A substantial shareholder and director filed multiple changes in interest in October; the titles do not specify whether shares were acquired or disposed.
A shareholder served a Notice of Person Ceasing on 14 September.
